## Hypothesis

The sniper_real_fills_grinder aimed to find parameter combinations that improve edge_capture over the baseline engine. The top keeper (vol_mult=1.1, body_min_cents=0.02, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.1, tp1_premium_pct=0.5, tp1_qty_fraction=0.5, runner_target_pct=2.0, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) was evaluated for its edge_capture and P&L performance.

## Mechanism

Entry logic: Based on a level break with volume confirmation (vol_mult=1.1), minimum body size (body_min_cents=0.02), and minimum star rating (min_stars=2). The strike is selected 2 strikes OTM (strike_offset=2). 
Exit logic: Uses a 10% premium stop (premium_stop_pct=-0.1), 50% TP1 at 50% quantity (tp1_premium_pct=0.5, tp1_qty_fraction=0.5), runner target of 200% premium (runner_target_pct=2.0), and profit-lock armed at 5% profit with a 5% stop offset (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05). Position size is 10 contracts, requiring proximity within $1.5 of the level and breaking above the open (require_break_above_open=true).
